_notes: All heroes start with 99 gold, 1 Healing Draught (consumable), and the shared 34-tile starting deck (see tiles.json).

heroes.name: The Scholar
heroes.charSelectText: A wise cat with a thirst for knowledge that no library could ever quench. Every book in the wastes has been read. Only The Tower, which no one has ever conquered, still keeps its secrets.
heroes.playstyle: Balanced spell-caster. The Spellbook crits on 5-letter words for +1 Energy next turn, the Barrier crits at 4 letters and draws 3 tiles. The Journal doubles the second cast of the same word in a fight.
heroes.who: A curious wizard cat who found the ancient Tablet and never put it down.
heroes.why: Hungry for knowledge. The great sorcerer at the top of The Tower is said to know every word ever spoken.

summary: LEXICORE's test is over. Its chamber now leads a million copies of The Scholar on a one-way voyage to the alien headquarters on the Moon.
At the command deck, the original cat opens the Tablet one last time. There is still so much left to learn, and so little time to learn it.
ending.finalQuote: …and so they rose, a million copies of one curious mind, eager to read the stars like the pages of a book no one had ever finished.

heroes.name: The Champion
heroes.charSelectText: A grey wolf in a tattered red cape who has won every fight in the wastes, and lost the joy of winning. Somewhere above the clouds waits the one opponent no one has ever beaten.
heroes.playstyle: Berserker with no shield. Berserker's Blood adds damage the more HP you are missing. A 3-letter Greatsword crit Breaks the enemy (Broken 3) but costs you HP. The Dumbbell builds Might fast, and a 5-letter crit heals 2 × Might. Passive: Adrenaline (below 50% HP: +0.5 Mult).
heroes.who: A red wolf who has beaten every rival in the wastes and grown bored of winning.
heroes.why: Looking for a real challenge. Rumor says the master of The Tower has never lost.

summary: LEXICORE's test is over. Its chamber now leads a million copies of The Champion on a one-way voyage to the alien headquarters on the Moon.
At the command deck, the original wolf watches the Moon grow larger and grins. For once, the next fight is bigger than the one who will fight it.
ending.finalQuote: …and so they rose, a legion of one restless heart, unsure of victory for the very first time, and never more alive.

passives.name: Adrenaline
passives.effect: Below 50% HP: +0.5 Mult on every cast.

heroes.name: The Mercenary
heroes.charSelectText: A hooded rat who never asks why, only how much. The contract is simple: climb The Tower and remove whatever sits at the top. Nobody who took it has ever come back to collect.
heroes.playstyle: Tempo assassin who chains many small casts. The Parrying Dagger crits at 3 letters and turns the hit into Shield too. The Utility Belt forges Fragile [ ! ] tiles (1 per 8 output); stack them at the end of a short dagger word for bonus Spell Power, and a 4-letter Belt crit refunds its Energy.
heroes.who: A hooded rat thief with a belt full of tricks and a very expensive contract.
heroes.why: Loot and riches. Somebody paid a fortune to have "the master of The Tower" removed. Nobody said what it was.

summary: LEXICORE's test is over. Its chamber now leads a million copies of The Mercenary on a one-way voyage to the alien headquarters on the Moon.
At the command deck, the original rat quietly rewrites the contract. Payment on delivery. Destination: the Moon.
ending.finalQuote: …and so they rose, a million thieves sharing a single contract, off to steal back the only treasure ever worth taking: tomorrow.
